enabled.description: Enable or disable the GCR service on startup.

work_dir.description: Working directory for temporary and runtime files.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used to track the daemon process.

log_level.description: Minimum log level to output. Set to 'debug' for verbose diagnostics.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Empty value logs to stdout/stderr instead.

listen_port.description: TCP port on which the GCR service listens for client connections.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads handling client requests.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before a client connection is closed.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for encrypted client communication.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the server TLS certificate file. Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_file.description: Path to the server TLS private key file. Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate for mutual TLS (mTLS) client verification. Leave blank to disable client cert authentication.

tls_sni_hostname.description: Optional hostname to present in TLS SNI during handshake. If empty, the system hostname is used.

rate_limit.max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per client per interval before throttling.

rate_limit.window_seconds.description: Time window (in seconds) over which rate limiting is applied.

acls.description: Access control rules — each entry defines an action (allow/deny) and optional IP range (CIDR).

name.description: Unique name for the ACL rule.

action.description: Whether to allow or deny matching clients.

network.description: IP network (CIDR notation) to match against client IP.

upstreams.description: Upstream backend servers to which GCR proxies requests. Each entry defines a backend name, host, port, and routing weight.

name.description: Unique identifier for the upstream (used for logging and management).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend server.

port.description: Port on which the backend server listens.

weight.description: Relative weight for load balancing (higher = more traffic).

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections to this upstream. If omitted, defaults to global max_connections.

cache.capacity.description: Maximum number of entries the cache can hold.

cache.default_ttl.description: Default time-to-live for cached entries (in seconds).

cache.policy.description: Cache eviction policy when capacity is exceeded.

health_check.enabled.description: Enable periodic health checks on upstream backends.

health_check.timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a health check response before marking unhealthy.

health_check.failures.description: Consecutive failed checks required to mark an upstream as unhealthy.

health_check.successes.description: Consecutive successful checks required to mark an upstream as healthy again.
